plugin.name: sbGitBlame
plugin.description: sbGitBlame displays inline Git commit and push information directly next to each code line in the editor.
plugin.change-notes: Version 1.0.10: - Resolved LockAccessDisallowed during editor paint. - Lock-free line painting and blank line detection. - Cleaned up threading model for IntelliJ 2024.2+ and 2026+.
